questions.question: From whom does David ask to be delivered in Psalm 140?
options: Proud kings who exalt themselves over God
Evil men and violent men who plan evil
Greedy merchants who cheat with false scales
False prophets who speak their own dreams
questions.answer: Evil men and violent men who plan evil

questions.question: What is David confident the LORD will do?
options: Maintain the cause of the afflicted and execute justice for the needy
Establish the throne of the king for a full thousand generations
Send down the rain upon the fields and fill all of the barns with grain
Subdue all of the nations and gather in their tribute to Zion
questions.answer: Maintain the cause of the afflicted and execute justice for the needy

questions.question: David calls the LORD his God and the strength of his salvation, covering his head in battle.
Deliver me, O LORD, from evil _____; preserve me from violent men.
I know that the LORD upholds justice for the _____ and defends the cause of the needy.
